title: ononis repens var. miniana
intro: Ononis repens var. miniana, commonly known as Restharrow, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Restharrow include wound healing, skin protection, and antimicrobial activity, making it a useful remedy for skin issues and infections. The bioactive constituents of Ononis repens var. miniana include isoflavones, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
